title: W1 Additive migration: Space-scoped posts, wall settings, access rules, copy of existing Space Circle posts

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: Space circles become a Community wall; thread plan /mnt/project-files/community-wall/PLAN.md

detail: posts.scope_type gains 'space' (scope_id is a polymorphic uuid with no FK); a space_wall_settings table holds the owner's choices (read: anyone or members, post: team and members, followers_interact); RLS and scoped_feed_for_viewer learn the space scope (keep the function-body guard in 20270345009100); existing Space Circle posts, replies and reactions are COPIED then verified, never moved; space_memberships and follows backfilled from the Space Circle roster, honouring space_circle_optouts. Additive and idempotent, timestamped after every migration on main and production; applied by this thread before merge (ADR-1111).
